name: Italia – potenza impegnata (ARERA, nessuna tariffa di capacità misurata)
assumed: The contracted power (3 kW typical) is the household's own and asked; the meter allows 10 % above it without limit and limits beyond that after a delay that is not modelled (D13 §18 G20, read 2026-09-24), so the site is held at the contract itself – the conservative side of the meter's own rule.
